items.title: Jeff Riddick Interview, 1983-08-01
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] It's got Leslie Chink. Oh, it's got Charlie Miller then, by then, huh? Mm-hmm. Yeah, Charlie Miller was... On Trombone. Yeah. And Mark. [INTERVIEWEE] Yeah.

ctx.x: Now, this is the first band at the famous door. Mm-hmm. Santo. And Lester's got his tenor.
Yeah. He's got his clarinet there. Yeah. Yeah. I never saw Chink play tuba there. Did he ever play tuba?
Yeah. Once in a while. He never had a tuba of his own at that time. Yeah. And someone would loan it to him.
